title: Code view
summary: A read-only, line-numbered listing for code or text: sticky gutter numbers a selection leaves out, highlighted lines, coloured segments, sideways scrolling.

props.name: lines
props.description: Lines to show; the text content when empty.

props.name: segments
props.description: Colouring: per line an array of { text, kind, match, word }; kind is keyword, string, comment, number, type, tag, attribute, directive, key or plain; match and word mark a search hit and the selected word.

props.name: highlight
props.description: Lines to highlight, such as 12 or 3, 5-7; the first is scrolled to the middle.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Cap the height, any CSS length.

props.name: fill
props.description: Fill the container; scrolls inside. Ignores maxHeight.

props.name: copy
props.description: Header Copy button; copies all lines.

events.name: pk-line-click
events.description: A click left a caret in a line's code: its line and zero-based column.

a11y: The body is a labelled, focusable region a keyboard can scroll. Line numbers are generated content: not selectable, not copied. A highlighted line has a background and a leading edge. Lines are text, never HTML.

examples.title: Highlighted lines
examples.html:
<pk-code-view label="order.js" highlight="2-3">function total(items) {
    const sum = items.reduce((a, i) => a + i.qty, 0);
    return sum;
}</pk-code-view>

examples.title: A slice starting at line 120, height capped
examples.html:
<pk-code-view label="log.txt" start="120" max-height="6rem">one
two
three
four
five
six</pk-code-view>

examples.title: Long lines scroll sideways
examples.html:
<pk-code-view label="long.txt">const message = 'This line is longer than the box, so it scrolls sideways and the numbers stay put.';
short</pk-code-view>
